حببتم (form I)

# حَبُبْتُمْ (ḥabubtum) /ħa.bub.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
# حَبِبْتُمْ (ḥabibtum) /ħa.bib.tum/: second-person masculine plural pas
